SUBJECT.description: Each Record has an index number corresponding to its position. Starts at index 1

CODE.description: Unique identifier for Web of Science Core Collection article (UID)

CATPERCENTILE.description: The percentile in which the paper ranks in its category and database year, based on total citations received by the paper. The higher the number of citations, the *higher* the percentile number

IS_BEST.description: Returns true if this category is the best

CAT_EXP_CITATION.description: Citations expected for this document based on the citation received by documents published in the same year, document type and subject area

CNCI.description: The Category Normalized Citation Impact (CNCI) of a document is calculated by dividing the actual count of citing items by the expected citation rate for documents with the same document type, year of publication and subject area

ACCESSION_NUMBER.description: Unique identifier for Web of Science Core Collection article (UID)

DOCUMENT_TYPE.description: Bibliographic term denoting the type of article

TIMES_CITED.description: Number of times an article has been cited

JOURNAL_EXPECTED_CITATIONS.description: Average number of citations to articles of the same document type from the same journal in the same database year

JNCI.description: Citation impact (citations per paper) normalized for journal, year and document type subject

IMPACT_FACTOR.description: Average number of times articles from a journal published in the past two years have been cited in the JCR year

HARMEAN_CAT_EXP_CITATION.description: The harmonic mean of citation rate values for all research fields to which an article is assigned. For more information about the citation rate metric, see the InCites Help File

AVG_CNCI.description: Citation impact (citations per paper) normalized for subject, year and document type

ESI_HIGHLY_CITED_PAPER.description: Entities that are included in ESI (top 1% for authors and institutions, top 50% for nations and journals). 0=No; 1=Yes

ESI_HOT_PAPER.description: The paper is an ESI Hot Paper, ranked in the top 1% by citations for field and age. 0=No; 1=Yes

IS_INTERNATIONAL_COLLAB.description: Publication has at least two different countries among the affiliations of the co-authors. 0=No; 1=Yes

IS_INSTITUTION_COLLAB.description: Indicates that more than one institution has contributed to the document. 0=No; 1=Yes

IS_INDUSTRY_COLLAB.description: Papers that list their organization type as a corporate for one or more of the co-authors affiliations. 0=No; 1=Yes

OA_FLAG.description: The document is published in an Open Access journal. Open Access Journals in InCites 2.0 are identical to Open Access Journals in InCites JCR - Gold Open Access. 0=No; 1=Yes

RNUM.description: Each Record has an index number corresponding to its position. Starts at index 1
